question: Which natural bioactive water-soluble phenolic compound is present in Fruits, vegetables, and grains with red, purple, blue, or black hues?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anthocyanins.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anthocyanins** are natural **bioactive water-soluble phenolic **compounds that are present in fruits, vegetables, and grains with** red, purple, blue, or black hues.**
 
• They are responsible for the** vibrant colors** in these foods and have been linked to various health benefits, including **anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Coumarins:**

 
 
• Phenolic compounds known as coumarins are made up of **benzene and α-pyrone rings **bonded together.
 
• The actions of coumarins include **vasodilatory, anti-inflammatory, and antithrombotic effects. **
 
 
 
• **Quercetin:**
 
 
• Plant pigment quercetin, or flavonol, is a strong **antioxidant flavonoid** that is mostly present in **onions, grapes, berries, cherries, broccoli, and citrus fruits**.
 
• It is a multipurpose antioxidant that has been shown to have protective properties against** tissue damage** brought on by a range of drug toxicity.
 
 
 
• **Naringenin:**
 
 
• Fruits high in naringenin include **oranges and tomatoes.**
 
• Naringenin is a subclass of **flavonoids**.
 
• Naringenin has** anti-estrogenic properties, hypocholesterolemic and hypolipidemic effects**, and regulates bodily lipid levels.
